SERVICE_HEADLINE: Mechanical and bodywork under one roof
TAGLINE: Most shops do one or the other. Here the mechanical work, the body repair and the paint happen in the same place, so nobody hands your car to a third party.
TRUST_1: Mechanical and body in one shop
SERVICES_INTRO: From a service light to a repaint, without your car moving between two businesses that blame each other.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Engine, brakes and servicing on foreign and domestic vehicles, including computer programming.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Collision work and refinishing done in house, so the timeline is ours to keep rather than to chase.
SERVICE_3_BODY: The car comes back looking like the repair was worth paying for.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
ABOUT_BODY: A Tarzana service centre covering both sides of the job: mechanical repair and vehicle computer programming, plus body repair, paint, detailing and car wash, on foreign and domestic vehicles. AAA members receive a discount on parts and labour.
